summary: Build emergency preparedness and health system resilience skills with practical plans, dashboards, and simulations. Train your team to respond faster.
lede: Emergency preparedness and health system resilience planning help health services prepare for disruptions to essential care. The course is for professionals in health operations, emergency coordination, continuity planning, and public health management; practical exercises cover hazard and readiness assessment, incident action planning with surge triggers, and continuity workflows. Participants also develop surveillance triggers and track corrective actions to improve response planning.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in health operations, emergency coordination, continuity planning, or public health management and need more structured, applied capability.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop and, if possible, a current emergency plan, continuity document, drill report, or service disruption log from your organization. Familiarity with health facility operations, public health coordination, or emergency response procedures will help you get the most value from the workshops.
